title: Ollie Owl Helps Find Mimi's Bell

scenes.title: Ollie Owl Helps Find Mimi's Bell
scenes.subtitle: Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Ollie Owl Helps Find Mimi's Bell! A cosy bedtime story.
The sun went down, and the stars came out. Mimi Kitten had played with Honey all afternoon.
Now Mama Bunny was walking Mimi home for bed.
Oh! My collar is so quiet. Where is my little bell?
Your jingly bell is gone?
Yes. I feel a little worried. I love my bell.
It's okay to feel worried, Mimi. When we need help, we can ask a friend.
Who has the best ears at night? Can you guess?
Ollie Owl! Owls can hear tiny sounds in the dark.
Hoo-hoo! Hello, friends. Did somebody call me?
Ollie, can you help me? My little bell is lost.
Of course I can help. Owls have very good ears. Let's all be very quiet, and listen.
Shh. Everyone listened.
Chirp, chirp, chirp!
Is that the jingle? What makes that sound?
It's a little cricket! Not a bell.
The little cricket sang in the grass. Then they heard another sound.
Ribbit, ribbit!
Who says ribbit? Can you say it with me?
A frog! Ribbit! That was funny. But it is not my bell.
Mimi, let's think. Where did you have your bell today?
I had my bell at nap time. I curled up in my cosy bed.
Hoo! Then let's go and listen by your cosy bed.
We'll all go together. I'll walk you home, Mimi.
So Mama Bunny walked Mimi and Honey to Mimi's cottage, and Ollie flew softly beside them.
Mimi's room was warm and cosy. Her round bed had a soft pink cushion.
Shh. Let's listen very, very carefully.
I will pat my blanket. Pat, pat, pat.
Jingle, jingle!
Did you hear that? What made that sound?
A jingle! It's Mimi's bell!
There it was! The little bell was snuggled in Mimi's blanket, all along.
My bell! It was in my bed the whole time!
Hoo-hoo! We found it together.
Thank you, Ollie. Thank you, Honey and Mama. I don't feel worried any more.
When you feel worried, it's good to ask for help. Friends help each other.
Mama Bunny put the bell back on Mimi's pink collar.
Jingle!
Now my collar sings again! But shh, it's sleepy time.
Before bed, let's do a sleepy kitten stretch together.
Can you stretch your arms up high, like a kitten?
Now a big, slow kitten yawn. Aaah.
Smell the flower. Breathe in.
Blow the candle. Breathe out.
One more time. Breathe in, and breathe out.
Mimi curled up in her cosy bed, with her little bell safe and sound.
Goodnight, Mimi. Goodnight, Ollie. Goodnight, little friends.
Who helped Mimi find her bell? Can you remember?
Her friends did! When you need help, you can ask a friend.
Mama Bunny and Honey waved goodnight, and went home to bed too.
Share with a friend and subscribe to Honey Bunny Kidz!
Hoo-hoo! Goodnight, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!
